chapters.title: Chapter 723: An Enticing Offer [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Kent, you’re back." The moment the guards escorted Kent, Vexthra, and Princess Lovina into the hall, Elder Farra said, smiling at the brat.
She was much more beautiful now. Of course, this was because she had found herself in the most secure and enriching environment. If anything, she was now free to focus on herself.

She had reached the peak of her cultivation and was also nearing perfect-level mastery of Chaos energy. Aside from firming her foundation, her time was spent working on her appearance, as any woman would.
She might have looked old before coming to the tower, but now she was much more eye-catching.
Kent, of course, smiled from his soul, revealing the genuineness of his emotions, especially after spending fourteen hours in the loving arms of his two wives.
"I see negotiations are in order," Kent said, stepping forward. As he approached everyone, he introduced his wives.
"This is Vexthra. She is my wife and a very knowledgeable fairy when it comes to cultivation. Speaking with her is like speaking to a goddess," he smiled, then turned to Princess Lovina.
"This is Princess Lovina, one of the poison experts—if not the best poison expert—you will ever find in this world. She is also my wife, and I brought her here to take a look at your wife."
A flicker of emotion appeared on King Thalirion’s face, wishing with his soul that Lovina would be able to save his wife. However, he held back and acted like a king first.
"Welcome, fairies. This is Elarion, the land of the Half-Elves. These ten are my most trusted elders and the backbone of this kingdom."
King Thalirion then introduced everyone. When he was done, Kent and his wives sat beside Tribe Chief Malthar and his three elders.
"So, did you conclude the alliance?" Kent asked, and King Thalirion nodded.

"We agreed to their alliance and will announce it to the world alongside an auction we will be organizing. I know you gave us the Spirit Grape Fruit to help with our cultivation, but we can’t give it to the 1.2 million Half-Elves living in Elarion. Therefore, we want to auction some and use the money to improve their lives.
I hope you don’t mind us being a little greedy."

Kent smiled. "It is just a fruit. If you’d need more, just let me know... But the auction and announcement of this alliance is a good thing. It will put you on the map, and from here onwards, you will start to soar as it should be."
Hearing Kent’s words, the king and his elders smiled.
"Thank you, Kent," King Thalirion said before moving on to the next topic.
"Also, while it might not be polite to ask, we want to ask that you become our guardian angel. We saw what you can do and how resourceful you are. We want to ask this of you.
Of course, we just want to use your name to deter others, considering words had already started about your feats an hour ago, and the fact that you killed Kenji, the Blade Whisperer.
Your name is now sharper than a well-sharpened sword, so you don’t have to worry about us; your name will do more than that."
⟦A wise king. He knew when to get what he wanted without making it sound like he was desperate. That is a good ruler.⟧

Before Kent could speak, the Tower had already completed its analysis of the king’s character. Kent smiled, both intrigued by how much the tower had learned from the three troublemakers he left inside the tower.
But the king had indeed asked Kent something he could not reject, not when they weren’t asking him to raise his sword and fight for them.
They just wanted to use his name to deter those who might seek trouble with him.
Of course, they had no idea that all of this was exactly what Kent was after. The idea of becoming their guardian was one of the main reasons Kent didn’t hesitate to be overly generous.
He needed the soul essence, and while the Foxkins were doing their best, he needed more than they were providing, so he could only work his magic and get what he wanted without asking for it.
’A race of over a million inhabitants. I say that will push my asteroid project up the timeline,’ Kent said inwardly, then smiled at the king.

"Using my name is not a problem for me. However, while you may not realize it, my role as your guardian angel is much more complex than you think. Of course, there is no harm in it, but the moment I accept the offer, you all will be connected to me forever.
Do you want that?"
"We don’t have a problem with that," the king answered immediately, already pleased that Kent hadn’t rejected them outright.
"I see. In that case, why don’t we make it official?" Kent looked at the king and his elders and asked, "Do you want me to become your guardian?"
"Yes," they answered, and all ten elders nodded with him.
⟦Do you want to become the guardian of the Elarion Half-Elves?⟧
’Yes.’
The moment Kent answered yes, the elders felt a protectiveness wash over them, just as the Foxkins did. All over Elarion, everyone suddenly felt some form of protectiveness enter their hearts.
The feeling was strange, but they felt as if they were shielded from the gravest danger...

Inside the palace hall, the king and his elders looked at Kent with surprised expressions. Kent just smiled. "No need to look surprised, everyone. What you felt was just a connection formed between us.
It will allow me to know when you are in danger, and as the guardian of your people, I will be obligated to come and safeguard everyone. You wanted me to become your guardian angel, so I became one."
The king and the elders nodded. "Thank you for becoming our guardian."
"Don’t worry about it." Of course, Kent was more than happy, feeling the soul essence flood in like a wave. His asteroid was growing at an unprecedented rate.
"Now, can you take us to the queen... She has suffered enough."

chapters.title: Chapter 724: A Battle Queen [Bonus]
paragraphs: Kent and his ladies were led out of the hall by the king. The elders stayed behind to fine-tune some details of their alliance with their new allies, the Bloodvein Tribe.
Kent knew this new alliance would be received in two ways: positively and negatively.
The good would come from people who wanted to meet a new kind of race, one they had never heard of before, but would like to learn about.

Of course, reaching them would be difficult, but knowing people like the Dwarves, who like to expand their markets, they would want to get close to the Bloodvein Tribe, meaning they would also want to get close to the Half-Elves.
That would be beneficial for both parties.

However, the bad would be the demons. After all, they had already tried to kill the Bloodvein Tribe. So they would become angry when they heard of this new development. But who could blame them? They were desperate, and so they chose to become savages.
As for how that would work out, Kent knew it would happen sooner rather than later. However, he wasn’t too concerned about that.
After all, the demons were next on his list. For now, he would let them behave as they wished. When he completed his mission of coming to the other continents, he would return to them.
"King Thalirion, may I ask how many of your kin you have in the Supreme Immortal Sect?" Kent asked as they moved toward a majestic building a few meters away.

"It is embarrassing, but for the past 1,000 years, only five of my kind have managed to make it inside. I have three children, and the other two are among the greatest geniuses we have ever had. The last entered 45 years ago but has yet to become an Inner Disciple. Not that the first four managed to become one either."
The king sighed. "Thankfully, the sect doesn’t send away those who couldn’t climb the ladder to the higher stages. So we only have five geniuses there."
"I see. I guess I didn’t have to know they aren’t having a good time there, considering the Elves wouldn’t make things easy for them."
The king nodded. "They’ve been a thorn in our side for far too long. However, once the queen is cured, some changes will happen."
"Oh, you make it sound like she holds the power to crush the Elves," Kent asked with a smile.
"She can’t crush them alone, but with her back at her peak, they wouldn’t dare. Not even the dragons would be arrogant in front of her.
She is a rather powerful warrior once you get to know her," King Thalirion said with a smile. Of course, he was happy to remember all the fond memories he had of his wife from several years ago.

They met on the battlefield. It was a clash against a horde of beasts on the ancient Battlefield of Parting. As the Prince of the Half-Elves, the then-Prince Thalirion went to the Ancient Battlefield to train with his guards.
However, they were ambushed by the Elves, which turned into a battle of life and death when, during their fight, a horde of lightning Tigers attacked them.
They fought fiercely—just he and his five guards—since the Elves left using teleportation talismans. This left them outnumbered and overpowered.

His guards fought fiercely and well, but they died. He was the only one left, cutting through one beast after another, trying to escape. But he couldn’t. However, he never stopped killing until a claw came for his neck, one that was destined to end him.

But that claw never reached him because just when he was almost at death’s door, a beautiful lady wielding two swords arrived and, like the grim reaper claiming lives, she moved with deadly grace, cutting one beast after another until every last one was slaughtered.
That was the day they met.
A prince and a warrior, both born and bred on the battlefield. She spent most of her time there, and for years, she honed her skills to the point she became one with the battlefield.
It took some time, but the prince who couldn’t forget his princess did his best to enter her heart, and ever since, they’ve become a happy couple.

So, when she took the dagger for him during his coronation, he lost his sanity and tried to get her help, but he came out empty-handed. Something that broke his heart. For years, he never talked to anyone, not even his elders.

However, when the Elves started to grow more aggressive, he had to become a king, not to save his people, but to protect the people his wife had fought many battles for, to ensure they had their place in the world.
He fought to ensure that one day, if his wife were to wake up, there would be a kingdom full of people waiting for him
"She sounds like an amazing woman," Vexthra said, walking on Kent’s right.
"She is..."
After a few more seconds, they arrived at a building made out of jade. It was a sleek-looking mansion, neither too large nor too small.
There were five guards at the gate. When they saw the king approach, they bowed. The king nodded and then led Kent and his wives inside.
He led them straight to the room where his wife was sleeping. The moment they entered, Kent’s eyes landed on a young lady sitting by the bed holding the hands of a rather beautiful woman.
Looking at her eyes, Kent raised his brow. ’That is an Elf.’
Of course, he knew he would find out soon enough why the king married an Elf, so he focused his attention on the young lady.
She had long, green hair, just like the woman on the bed, and a build that wasn’t too busty nor too slim. She had the perfect body shape to turn any man’s head when she passed.
"This is my daughter, Princess Elowen. She is the youngest of my children, and the next person we hope can enter the sect and bring some glory to the Half-Elf race.
Elowen, this is Kent Madson, a human, and his two wives, also humans. They are here to see if they can help your mother."
Princess Elowen turned and looked at Kent and his two wives.
"Nice to meet you. Please, can you really save my mother?"
’Don’t say anything, shameless Kent, she is grieving.’ Before Kent could answer, Vexthra warned him through the harem connection.
[Relax, Vex.]
Kent stared at the worried look on the Half-Elf princess’s face and smiled. "Don’t worry, she will be up and running in no time."

chapters.title: Chapter 725: Waking The Queen Up [Bonus]
paragraphs: Kent turned to Princess Lovina, who nodded and walked toward the bed with him. Vexthra was beside him.
Looking at Sleeping Beauty, Kent couldn’t help but make a cheeky comment, "The Elves clearly have the perfect beauty genes."

The queen had been sleeping for over a thousand years already; however, while her cultivation had regressed to the 4th level Root Sovereign stage, her beauty remained. She still looked more gorgeous than ever.

Vexthra pinched Kent’s side, prompting him to smile. His comment was rather cheeky but funny. Princess Lovina walked closer to the sleeping beauty, placed her hand on her forehead, and started channeling her energy into her body.
The king held his daughter in his arms as they looked at the Poison Beauty work her magic. They knew this was their last chance, so they were more than eager to hear some good news.
Kent stood there calmly while Vexthra sneakily studied the worried expressions on the faces of the king and his daughter.
This was her chance to study mortals, and as she looked at them, she began to see and feel things that she had let go of in her quest to become a god.
Kent smiled slightly, knowing his goddess wife was taking her quest to become human yet again more seriously than she let on.

But he didn’t mind her and continued to pay attention to Lovina, who still had her finger on the Queen’s forehead. After ten minutes, she removed her hand, and Princess Elowen quickly asked a question.
"Please, can you save my mother... please..." The desperation was palpable to everyone in the room.
Princess Lovina smiled and walked toward her. She took her hand and assured her, "Don’t worry, Princess Elowen, your mother can be saved. I will wake her up in a few minutes."
The Half-Elf princess broke into tears, planting her face in Princess Lovina’s chest, and started sobbing. Kent shook his head, smiling, while Vexthra moved closer and took Princess Elowen’s hand.
A few moments later, she broke free and blushed, looking at the wet marks on Princess Lovina’s chest. "Sorry... I-I was just too emotional."
Princess Lovina smiled, "Don’t worry about it." She then turned to Kent.
"Can you concoct the Radiant Soul Pill? I have the ingredients already."
"I can do it," Kent answered and asked, "What grade do you want?"
"Tier 7 or 8 will do."
"Bring the ingredients and I will work on it for you."
"You are the best," Princess Lovina said, and Kent smiled, "I know."
Vexthra just smirked. "Why do you need a Radiant Soul Pill? If my memory serves me right, that pill isn’t an antidote but a nourishing pill."
Lovina nodded. "I know, big sister. There are two ways to save her. One is to burn the poison completely from her body. However, doing that would just be a waste.

She was poisoned using the Eternal Nightshade poison. The poison was meant to corrode her heart and kill her in the most painful way. However, thanks to the item protecting her heart, the poison couldn’t penetrate it.
Now, what many don’t know is that the Eternal Nightshade poison is meant to work within seconds. The moment it entered her body, it was meant to kill her within seconds.

However, I have a feeling she managed to resist it, and this was because she has some level of poison affinity. It was the only reason she survived, and thanks to the device protecting her heart, she was able to defend it."
Princess Elowen shuddered, hearing what Lovina was saying.
"Honestly, I have to give it to her; she is fierce. To be able to handle poison like that, she had to have a relatively strong will.
Defending against such a poison is like feeling a million needles pass through her blood vessels. It is painful than words can describe.
But thanks to her fierceness, she might have just saved herself and secured her future. I can’t in good conscience burn the poison away while I can transform it and use it to nourish her poison core.

The 1,000 years she remained asleep have helped her to form a poisonous core. Seriously, this lady is fiercer than you know. She continued to endure 1,000 years of pain, hoping to convert the poison into a core.
If given another 1,000 years, she would have succeeded and woken up on her own. But I will speed the process up and help her awaken with a newfound power, one born out of poison."
Kent shook his head, watching the excited look on Lovina’s face. It was like she had found her first poison project, one she would love to work her magic on.
Of course, she wasn’t done. "When I am done, if she was once respected, then she would be feared now. Her spirit is fierce..."
"Alright, my Poison Fairy, why don’t we get back to waking her up?" Kent laughed, causing Lovina to blush slightly before turning to Vexthra.
"Big sister, I need some of the fruits in the garden." Vexthra nodded and vanished, startling the king and his daughter. Kent just shook his head.

Vexthra could have just said, ’Excuse me,’ before vanishing like a ghost. She just left without saying a word. However, a few seconds later, she appeared holding a large plate of some of the best fruits found only in the love garden.
"That will do. She needs to gather as much energy as possible in the first few minutes. And since we can’t help her with that, she can get that from the fruits."
Lovina turned to the sleeping beauty and formed a hand seal, conjuring a rune. She gestured forward, making it enter the queen’s forehead.
Then she pressed her index finger against her forehead.
A few seconds into the process, the queen’s eyelid shook. However, she didn’t open it... Lovina continued to keep her finger on her forehead for a few more seconds before slowly opening her eyes.
"MOM!"
The princess called out, eyes moist as she looked at her mother sleeping on the bed, her eyes open now. Vexthra made sure she didn’t move closer, fearing she might disrupt the process.
Three minutes later, Lovina removed her hand and sighed. "Welcome back to the land of the living, Queen Jascia."

chapters.title: Chapter 726: Radiant Soul Pill (1)
paragraphs: It took a while for the queen to recover her sight. She had been in darkness for over a thousand years, so she had to adjust her vision to the light.
But when she did, she was greeted by Princess Lovina offering her a ’Spirit Grape Fruit.’
"You don’t have much energy in you, so eat this for now until you can start absorbing the natural energy in the air." Princess Lovina said before feeding the fruit to her.
It was slow at first, taking a few bites every few seconds.

Even the taste of the fruit was foreign to her. But since they weren’t after the taste, Princess Lovina kept feeding her different types of fruits for three hours until color started returning to her face.

That was when Princess Elowen was allowed to approach her mother. "Mom," she said, taking her arms. Of course, the queen didn’t say anything, but a smile appeared at the corner of her lips when she saw her youngest daughter appear before her.
"Mom... Are you alright?" Princess Elowen asked, but Princess Lovina answered instead.
"She needs to recover some more before her voice will return. For now, she can only keep eating the fruits while Kent works on the pill.
The moment that is done, and I feed her the pill, she will be able to speak again."
The Half-Elf Princess nodded. She didn’t want to argue about it. Just seeing her mother awake and in recovery was all she ever wanted.
Kent stood on the side, looking at Princess Elowen with a calm yet curious expression.
First, she is an expert in Peak Core Formation, which is impressive. However, considering her mom has been comatose for over a thousand years, does that make her over a thousand years old?
Kent’s mind wandered as he looked at Princess Elowen. He quickly scanned her, and her age was indeed over 1000 years. If that were the case, wouldn’t it disqualify her from entering the Flame Tower?

After all, they are looking for 100 years or below. She is practically their ancestor. Then again, Kent doesn’t know anything about the dynamics of the processes that go into entering the Supreme Immortal Sect.

First, there are various ways of entering, and one of them is comprehending a flame art from the Flame Tower up to the third level. The moment that is achieved, the Supreme Immortal Sect will allow you to take their exams to join them.
But aside from Kent, he also seemed to remember Shax telling him something along the lines of having presence on any of the continents.
Per what Shax said, Kent, being known on the other continents, can attract the attention of the Supreme Immortal Sect.
Initially, he planned to conquer the continents, a move he intended to use to gain the attention of the sect.
But then it changed when he learned of the Flame Tower...
So it seems the princess has the protocol—one that, through her overwhelming powers, she was given an invitation to take the entrance exams without having to know any flame Art...
That can be the only reason why she would be able to join the sect.
King Thalirion noticed Kent paying more attention to his daughter. Of course, the curious look on Kent’s face made him grasp what he was thinking.

After all, he had told him about their belief that the princess was their last hope for gaining entry into the sect and perhaps rising to the point where she could have the privilege of meeting the Pill Empress and receiving help for her mother.
"She is just like her mother. Fierce and determined when wielding her swords," the king said, a little relieved now.
"I can see that," Kent said, and the king nodded.

"She declined to enter the Flame Tower hundreds of times. After she learned that those who join the sect using the Flame Tower are not taken seriously upon entering, she began to train to gain entry through invitation.
She received the invitation a month ago and will be entering in a month’s time when the doors to welcome new disciples open. She is fierce, that is for sure."
"I guess that is commendable. She knew what she wanted, and while she needed it quickly, she also wanted to succeed at all costs, so she worked diligently to achieve it.
And now that the only problem in her life was being handled, I am sure her mom waking up will push her to strive even further. This is good for her."
King Thalirion nodded to Kent’s words.

"Kent, these are the ingredients." Princess Lovina gave Kent the ingredients. Her primordial spirit was relaxing after reaching Tier 8, so she worked on gathering the ingredients from the many herb gardens inside her Poison Space.
"You have to do it here. The moment the pill is formed, I will start the process. Just the smell alone is enough to start the process, so we can’t waste it."
"Good for me if that is okay for you, King Thalirion."
The king nodded, and Kent sat down, taking out his cauldron. This one was a new one he bought from the tower. It was a legendary grade. It can be used for pills ranging from Tier 1 to Tier 9.

Naturally, a good alchemist can even use a Legendary grade Cauldron to concoct Tier 12 Pills. It is a matter of how effective the technique being used is and how much mastery the alchemist has over it.
Kent is not there yet...
’Time to test how powerful my pill flame has become,’ Kent muttered. Since he had managed to raise its quality to Tier 6, all aspects of it had also strengthened.
He would only be using the [Purifying] and [Nourishing] aspects of his Chaos soul flame to work on the pill, so Kent lit it up and started heating the cauldron.
The golden flame spread around the cauldron, giving it a brilliant glow, one that made Kent smile.
’Having a flame straight from my soul feels different. It makes me feel like I have accomplished something worthwhile.’ Kent smiled.

’But of course I did achieve something great. Not many were able to awaken soul flames. Some inherited it from Spirit Flames...So indeed have I made a great achievement, awakening my own.’ The pride he felt made him very happy.
’Next time, I will purchase flames or hunt for flame spirits that can be used for alchemy.’ The more flame spirits that have alchemical value, the easier it gets when used in alchemy.
Kent had already seen what the Blue Void Flame and the Purifying Flames could do, so he wanted to get more of them.

The moment he became a Pill Saint, he would unlock his third alchemy flame, but until then, he wanted to make sure he got some things on his own. He had to work extra hard because he had to surpass his past selves.
He must become a different kind of genius since that was primarily why he reincarnated in the first place. While his past may help him, he must also look for opportunities on his own.

After heating the cauldron, Kent picked two ingredients and tossed them into the cauldron, causing the king, his daughter, and even the queen, who was now sitting, to show both shocked and surprised expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 727: Radiant Soul Pill (2)
paragraphs: Though they didn’t know Kent, seeing him toss two ingredients into the cauldron at the same time caused them to widen their eyes.

They knew alchemy to some degree, so they understood that extracting the medicinal essence from the herbs was the first step in achieving the goal. Of course, they also knew it was absolutely imperative not to make a mistake at that stage.
If Kent were to make a mistake at the beginning, the pill would come out damaged or incomplete. Extracting essence from two different ingredients simultaneously was simply too reckless.
However, they all knew people who could do that. One of them was the Pill Princess, who dominated the pill world before she was invited to the sect by the Pill Empress herself.
She was able to do what Kent was doing—extracting essence from multiple ingredients simultaneously. It was something just too shocking.
So watching Kent do it was like the biggest shock to them. It was telling them the pill princess wasn’t the only genius to walk the pill path.
However, they also understood that some people are born geniuses, so they could only watch as he tossed the second set of ingredients.

’At this rate, the moment I get my Soul Flame to the 7th Tier, I will be able to extract essence from at least four ingredients. Of course, the aim is to be able to toss all ingredients into the cauldron and extract the essence at the same time.
Both my mental and spiritual strength are at a stage where I can do that. The only thing now is to practice more and raise the quality of my soul flame.’

While the king and his family were shocked when he tossed two ingredients into the cauldron and started dual extraction, Kent was thinking of complete extraction—one where all ingredients are thrown into the cauldron at once.
Then again, geniuses just don’t know when to stop, considering their potential is limitless.
After tossing the fifth set of ingredients into the cauldron and extracting the essence, Kent began the second stage, where he burned impurities and condense the pill.
Naturally, most alchemists tend to burn impurities first before condensing the pill. That is the easiest way to go about pill making.
However, Kent’s method is different. The techniques Kent was using had some major changes. The first was the condensing and burning of impurities.

Kent was merely burning off the impurities and ensuring that the medicinal essence he had extracted didn’t burn away too quickly. Of course, his understanding wasn’t yet deep enough, so he couldn’t achieve complete extraction or purification.
He might want to train for a few more years if that’s his goal. But his techniques allowed him to keep the medicinal potency of the pill at a higher level than most.
The moment that was done, he changed techniques to condense the pill fully.
"It is starting, so get ready, my poison queen," Kent said
Princess Lovina nodded and formed a hand seal. Vexthra moved back with Princess Elowen. "It will hurt for a few minutes, Queen Jascia, so endure it, and it will be worth it in the end."
She blinked, signaling that Lovina could go ahead. She had been through a thousand years of pain. A few minutes wouldn’t break her.
"I am ready," Lovina said, and Kent nodded. A few seconds later, the smell of something fragrant started seeping from the cauldron.
Lovina formed another hand seal, causing her eyes to turn purple. She had activated one of her overpowered skills and pressed her hand against the queen’s forehead.
"Don’t resist the process. It will be over before you know it." After saying that, she circulated her energy and started directing it through the queen’s body.
Her energy went through her body for a few minutes before Lovina changed the circulation path and moved her energy toward her core.

There, beside the withered core the queen formed years ago, was a black core. It was much smaller compared to the withered core, but the energy pulsating from it was much more potent than one would expect.
Her energy enveloped it and then enveloped her withered core, too. Then, from the outside, Princess Lovina’s energy flared.

It was at that moment that the queen felt the pain. "Don’t resist, Queen Jascia. I am merging the Poison Core with your withered core. The moment that is done, you will gain more energy than you can dream of."

The king and his daughter held their breath, fists clenched, as they watched the pained expression on the queen’s face. Thankfully, like Lovina said, it lasted for a few minutes before the pain subsided.
At that moment, Kent was also done with the pill, filling the room with its fragrance. "Here you go." After taking out the pill, he handed it over to Lovina, who quickly brought it to the queen.
"Swallow this and let the energy wash through your body."
The queen did as she was told and swallowed the pill. The energy entered her body, filling her with a potent nourishing energy.`
A few seconds later, what Lovina was after was activated. The feeling of great power, one the queen hadn’t felt before, entered her body and started to rise.
Her eyes widened, causing Lovina to smile.
"What you are feeling is a mutated power formed from your Spiritual Core and the incomplete Poison Core you formed.

I had to complete the formation and merge it so that, in the future, instead of consuming poison to grow your Poison Core and absorbing spiritual energy to strengthen your cultivation, you can do both, regardless of what you consume.
So if you consume poison, your cultivation will also be affected. And the same happens to your poison potency when you cultivate.

This also means that while most people find it hard to build upon their foundation after reaching the peak, you will continue to grow your foundation wider should you choose to stay here forever without ascending."
The king, her daughter, and the queen were visibly shaken, having heard something so ridiculous yet so real. It was like Lovina had just broken the limit placed on the world.
While the queen will be at the Core Formation, her foundation will continue to grow, transforming her into a freak in any medium world.
That is just too much, and to some extent, wasted, should she choose to stay in Sonox. Of course, Kent just smiled, knowing what he knew.
’It was like the universe and the tower knew this would happen, so they gave me something to fix that.’ Kent smiled and watched as the queen’s cultivation base started to rise.

After tossing the fifth set of ingredients into the cauldron and extracting the essence, Kent began the second stage, where he burned impurities and condense the pill.
Naturally, most alchemists tend to burn impurities first before condensing the pill.
That is the easiest way to go about pill making.
However, Kent’s method is different.
The techniques Kent was using had some major changes.
The first was the condensing and burning of impurities.
Kent was merely burning off the impurities and ensuring that the medicinal essence he had extracted didn’t burn away too quickly.
Of course, his understanding wasn’t yet deep enough, so he couldn’t achieve complete extraction or purification.
He might want to train for a few more years if that’s his goal.
But his techniques allowed him to keep the medicinal potency of the pill at a higher level than most.
The moment that was done, he changed techniques to condense the pill fully.
"It is starting, so get ready, my poison queen," Kent said
Princess Lovina nodded and formed a hand seal.
Vexthra moved back with Princess Elowen.
"It will hurt for a few minutes, Queen Jascia, so endure it, and it will be worth it in the end."
She blinked, signaling that Lovina could go ahead.
She had been through a thousand years of pain.
A few minutes wouldn’t break her.
"I am ready," Lovina said, and Kent nodded.
A few seconds later, the smell of something fragrant started seeping from the cauldron.
Lovina formed another hand seal, causing her eyes to turn purple.
She had activated one of her overpowered skills and pressed her hand against the queen’s forehead.
"Don’t resist the process.
It will be over before you know it." After saying that, she circulated her energy and started directing it through the queen’s body.
Her energy went through her body for a few minutes before Lovina changed the circulation path and moved her energy toward her core.
There, beside the withered core the queen formed years ago, was a black core.
It was much smaller compared to the withered core, but the energy pulsating from it was much more potent than one would expect.
Her energy enveloped it and then enveloped her withered core, too.
Then, from the outside, Princess Lovina’s energy flared.
It was at that moment that the queen felt the pain.
"Don’t resist, Queen Jascia.
I am merging the Poison Core with your withered core.
The moment that is done, you will gain more energy than you can dream of."
The king and his daughter held their breath, fists clenched, as they watched the pained expression on the queen’s face.
Thankfully, like Lovina said, it lasted for a few minutes before the pain subsided.
At that moment, Kent was also done with the pill, filling the room with its fragrance.
"Here you go." After taking out the pill, he handed it over to Lovina, who quickly brought it to the queen.
"Swallow this and let the energy wash through your body."
The queen did as she was told and swallowed the pill.
The energy entered her body, filling her with a potent nourishing energy.`
A few seconds later, what Lovina was after was activated.
The feeling of great power, one the queen hadn’t felt before, entered her body and started to rise.
Her eyes widened, causing Lovina to smile.
"What you are feeling is a mutated power formed from your Spiritual Core and the incomplete Poison Core you formed.

I had to complete the formation and merge it so that, in the future, instead of consuming poison to grow your Poison Core and absorbing spiritual energy to strengthen your cultivation, you can do both, regardless of what you consume.
So if you consume poison, your cultivation will also be affected.
And the same happens to your poison potency when you cultivate.

This also means that while most people find it hard to build upon their foundation after reaching the peak, you will continue to grow your foundation wider should you choose to stay here forever without ascending."
The king, her daughter, and the queen were visibly shaken, having heard something so ridiculous yet so real.
It was like Lovina had just broken the limit placed on the world.
While the queen will be at the Core Formation, her foundation will continue to grow, transforming her into a freak in any medium world.
That is just too much, and to some extent, wasted, should she choose to stay in Sonox.
Of course, Kent just smiled, knowing what he knew.
’It was like the universe and the tower knew this would happen, so they gave me something to fix that.’ Kent smiled and watched as the queen’s cultivation base started to rise.

chapters.title: Chapter 728: Lady Aelith’s Warning [Bonus]
paragraphs: (Elven Kingdom: Sylveria - The Queen’s Palace.)
Queen Elenara was resting on her throne, waiting for good news from her warriors or her mother, who had gone to retrieve Kent.
She knew deep in her heart that what she was doing was wrong, but greed can blind even the wisest and the most innocent.
She was hungry for more power, so she chose to pursue Kent, and now she knew success was almost within her grasp.
However, an hour after she deployed her men, the door to her throne room burst open, and a pale Lady Aelith entered.
"Mother... what happened?" The queen panicked when she saw the look of shock on her mother’s face. She immediately approached her, but a glare from Lady Aelith made her halt in her steps.
"Mother... what—" She couldn’t understand where the hostility was coming from. However, Lady Aelith said nothing and sat in her chair for ten full minutes before she spoke.

"Listen well, you idiot. Under no circumstances should you ever, even in the slightest, antagonize that human freak. Don’t even think about going against him with the entire Elven army. You won’t succeed.
Even if he appears here right now and demands the throne, give it to him, for if you go against him, you will not only doom yourself but the whole Elven race.
The Hand can handle its own business. The human named Kent Madison is off-limits. Don’t go against him ever again. That is all I can tell you."
With that, Lady Aelith vanished from the throne room, leaving a shocked queen unsure of how to take the warning she had just been given.
"What just happened?" she asked herself, looking at the spot where her mother had sat just a few seconds ago. "What happened so badly that someone like Mother would be scared to this degree?"
"I need to know more."
"Somebody, summon Dailon here." A few minutes later, the leader of the Elven unit she had sent to retrieve Kent appeared in the hall, looking even paler than Lady Aelith.
This alone deepened her frown.
"Talk," the queen said. "Tell me what happened and don’t leave anything out."
Dailon was scared, but he had to talk, so he did. "The human you sent us to retrieve is a monster, my queen. When we arrived, he was waiting for us outside. It was like he knew we were coming.
Of course, we didn’t expect much from him, so we underestimated him. But that was our mistake—not that it makes any difference—but he was much more dangerous than we thought.

He spoke just a few words, but everything he said entered our minds to the point that we wanted nothing but to slaughter each other... I said we because I wanted to kill my own men because, at that moment, that was all I could think of."
The queen shuddered in her chair.
’Mind control... he can mind control Peak Core Formation experts?’ the queen wondered, feeling her heartbeat rise.

Of course, she had yet to hear the worst, and Dailon also wasn’t going into detail, knowing that telling her about what he had discovered between his wife and one of his soldiers would be a waste of time.
"He knew things, secrets that we haven’t told anyone... He was able to say things we did, and, strangely, even helped us catch a spy of the Dark Elves among my men.
But aside from that, he was in our heads, manipulating us to the point where I am not sure we can function as a unit anymore.
He defeated us without even killing a single one of us.

However, the horror came when the Hand unit arrived. It was the most brutal and jaw-dropping massacre I have ever witnessed. He killed every last one of them using just his fist. When he was done, he was bathed in their blood.
Thinking about it even gives me chills. But he was one scary bastard whom I wouldn’t want to face ever again, even if that means I will lose my role as army general.
The last thing that happened was when it was discovered that Tiger Fang was actually Kenji, the Blade Whisperer."
This time, Queen Elenara stood up from her seat briefly before sitting back down. Her hands were shaking—not from fear, but from anger.
She knew what Kenji did to her people, the number of people that died because of him, so hearing that Tiger Fang was the cause of it all was just too much.
"What happened to him?" she asked.
"That is the weird part, my queen. What happened to him was the most horrifying thing I have ever witnessed... and I have seen a lot of evil things.

I don’t know how the human did it, but he was able to get inside Kenji’s mind and ordered him to cut himself 10,000 times without screaming or crying. His order was absolute, one that made every last one of us, including the Half-Elves, understand one thing.
If Kenji were evil, then the human named Kent Madson is the creator of evil. I know I am not in the business of advising the queen, but from what I saw, I have one piece of advice for you, my queen."
"Make peace with the Half-Elves because they have Kent Madison’s backing and a race from the Dead Region."

The queen was left stunned, unsure of what to say or even how to react. All she had just heard sounded so bizarre to her, yet she knew without a shred of doubt that General Dailon wouldn’t lie to her.
This meant Kent Madson was dangerous, and hearing the Half-Elves were now in league with a new race, she knew things were about to change.

Of course, she had two roads paved for her... one where she let go of her animosity with the Half-Elves, and the other where she continued, which, from what she had heard from General Dailon, would not end well for her.
"You can go, Dailon... Rest for now, and when you recover, come back. I have some questions for you."
General Dailon nodded and left.

The queen remained in her chair for a few minutes before she also left. Things had just become much more dire now... if she didn’t act quickly, the flood would swallow her and everything she held dear.

chapters.title: Chapter 729: The Queen Has Been Cured [Bonus]
paragraphs: Level 5 Root Sovereign...
Level 6 Root Sovereign...
Level 7 Root Sovereign...
Level 1 Core Formation...

Queen Jascia’s cultivation base continued to rise steadily, already moving past the peak of the Root Sovereign stage. The mutation formed between her standard core and the Poison core was far more impressive than one would expect.
Within half an hour, she advanced to the 9th level of the Core Formation stage and began refining her core. Unfortunately, after refining her core four times, the process came to an end.
However, she had already become someone to be feared.

Her aura had stabilized, and right now, aside from the sharpness of sword intent she used to possess, she now had potent poison qi in her aura—one that, if she wanted, could poison anyone with just her presence.

But as a swordsman, Kent knew that with the poison qi in her intent, she could become much more dangerous on the battlefield. Using it to lace her sword, she would suffocate those around her, making it much more hazardous.
’And just like that, she had become new.’ Kent was happy for the queen, who was now recuperating.
That lasted for two hours before she opened her eyes, meeting the gaze of a teary daughter and an emotional king who never thought he would see his wife’s smile ever again.
"Mom—"
Princess Elowen struggled to find words, but she was too overcome with emotion to speak.
Vexthra and Lovina stood beside the bed, smiling, while Kent stood far back watching them. After a while, the queen finally found her voice and spoke, looking at Princess Lovina and Vexthra.
"Thank you."
"Dont worry about it, Queen Jascia..." Princess Lovina answered...
Because she hadn’t spoken for a while, he tone was rough, but after a while her sweet voice came back to her. That one she had a thousand years ago.

"Stop crying, Elowen, I am fine...More than fine," She spoke, brushing her hand through Princess Elowwn’s hair. Of course, the poor princess could only cry her eyes out, making the queen turn to her husband.
She smiled, "Brat...Looks like you are doing well...Your aura even changed...what happened?"
The king smiled, shaking his head as a tear fell from his eyes.

Hearing his wife return to her previous self made her very emotional. Never once did she call him by his real name. From the day they met to when she took the dagger for him, she had always called him ’brat’.

If she were to call him by his real name, he would have realised she wasn’t fully well and requested Lovina to take another look at her, just to be sure. But the signature name ignited the flames of his emotion, drawing out hidden emotions.
"Almost dying on me changed a few things...Now I can hold my own in combat if that is what you want to hear," King Thalirion replied with a smile.
"I guess we will see in a few days...For now, I have to find that bastard and kill him."
And finally, the queen is back.
While most queens hide in their throne room, manipulating events, she likes to be on the battlefield, slaughtering monsters and enemies alike.
So, hearing her plans for the next few days didn’t come as a surprise to King Thalirion. However, his smile was that of a guilty one as he turned and looked at Kent, who was also smiling.
"I am sorry, Queem Jascia, the blade whisperer is dead," Kent responded from the back, causing the queen to take a deep sigh.
"Did he suffer?" She asked
"Not quite, but if there is any consolation, I have plans to visit the underworld in the future, perhaps I will add more to his suffering then."
The queen smiled while the king shuddered.
"Thank you."
"Anytime"

Just like that, two evil beings agreed, causing the king to imagine what awaited Kenji when Kent truly finds him in the underworld. Of course, he doesn’t want to talk about it, but he wondered what his wife would have done if Kenji were still alive.
’I guess Kent saved me a whole lot of nightmares. Knowing her, she would have relished the torture to the point I would have had to beg her to end it. This is a good outcome, though an evil one.’
After a few more pleasantries were exchanged, the King called Kent out and handed him a token, "This is your token to enter the competition tomorrow.
Had I not announced there would be five slots, I would have given you one, considering the competition might waste your time."
"Dont worry about it. I am just 21 years old, things like this should be what I should invest my time in." Kent smiled, taking the token.
The king nodded.
"I will be going back to the palace. I have a few things to discuss with the Elders...and no, you don’t have to be there...go spend time with your family"
The king nodded and went back inside. A second later, Vexthra and Lovina walked out and joined Kent as they moved back to the palace.
"Good Job, Lovina, you did well," Kent praised Lovina, who smiled.
"So, when are you moving to the second floor?" Kent asked Vexthra.

"The moment we return. We’ve already found all we could on the first floor, so we will move to the second and clear it as quickly as possible. Unity is the priority now, so we want to help her to the best of our abilities."
"That is good. When the eight new Undead join in 11 days, the speed of searching will hasten. But I will be coming around when I have nothing to do."

"Dont worry about us, Kent. Just focus on your things. You’ve been here for less than a day, but you’ve already made a significant impact. I wonder what would become of you after a week," Vexthra said with a chuckle.
"No need to be jealous, Vex, you are a goddess..." Kent teased, and Vexthra pinched his nose
Lovina laughed.
When they got back to the Palace, the elders quickly bombarded them with questions. They were eager to know whether the queen was well.
"The queen is cured. She needs to rest for a few hours, and she will be back on her feet."

chapters.title: Chapter 730: Day Of The Competition
paragraphs: Just like that, a day has passed since Lovina cured the queen.
She managed to get down from her bed and walk on her own two feet. It was a little difficult at first, but she managed to carry herself slowly without anyone’s help.
Eventually, she could move. That was when she went to the palace to meet the elders. When the guards and maids saw her, they all became emotional.
Naturally, they all knew the reason why the Elves grew spines was because the Queen was hurt and couldn’t actively oppose them.
She wasn’t like her fellow Elves, who chose to suppress the half-elves. She actually wanted to help them, so despite being an Elf, she married a Half-Elf and was received with open arms.
Her battle prowess was something that won them over. So they loved her unconditionally. But aside from that, she was also someone who didn’t like to use her status to suppress anyone.

She had many qualities, but the main reason was that they all cherished her for her sacrifice, as she had taken the dagger meant for the King. That showed just how much she truly loved the Half Elves.

So when the guards, maids, and elders saw her, they all became emotional. Thankfully, she had the energy to stand on her own feet, as most of the maids surrounded her, just as they used to back in the day.
Of course, Princess Elowen was the most clingy of them all.
On the other hand, after Vexthra and Princess Lovina spent a few hours with Kent, they left for the dungeon. They would soon be climbing to the second floor.
(Grand Matron Arena - Elenara Kingdom)
Meanwhile, the day of the competition had arrived, and the Grand Matron Arena, one of the largest arenas in the kingdom, was filled to the brim.
Thousands of Half Elves came to watch the competition that would select five people to enter the Flame Tower in three weeks.
"Have you heard? A human will be participating in the competition. I don’t know why he was allowed, but I look forward to seeing how he fares against our geniuses," someone in the audience said.
"I am looking forward to that too. I heard he is no pushover. He even dared to cut the limbs off those arrogant elves."
"I heard that, too. It turns out the Elves are all bark but no bite. I expected them to come and attack him by now, but nothing happened."
"What do you expect? It is the Elves... all they know is how to bully the weak."
As more comments were exchanged, the registered contestants began to arrive. 1,204 people registered—or more like, they were the ones who qualified to participate.
As they appeared, their fans started cheering for them. Of course, there were a few who had no fans, but even so, having a chance to participate in this enterprise made them happy.

Most were experts in the Core Formation stage, with cores refined approximately five times. Those are the true geniuses, considering it takes most thousands of years to rise through the ranks to that stage.
A typical example is the human continent. Since their decline, only a few have managed to rise through the ranks. Humans lack the resources to cultivate like the Elves and Half-Elves do.
That was the sole reason the humans were lacking.
However, on other continents, some geniuses, such as the 1204 contestants, have already reached the Core formation stage and refined their cores while still being under 100 years old.
This was because they had resources at their disposal — resources that those on the human continent did not have.
Most also spent their time on the Ancient Battlefield of Parting, giving them access to many more resources and a wealth of combat experience.
"Look, that is Norion... He is so cool."
"Norion is indeed cool. He has already refined his core five times, and I heard that he even killed a Peak Core Formation Flame Beast and inherited its flame.
There is no doubt he has already secured a place in the five."
"That is true. Madea is also here. She has refined her core five times, and as a natural user of the flame element, this should be easy enough for her."

Being a guardian made him like a god, so he could spot the spies hidden among the thousands of Half Elves in the Arena. Of course, they posed no immediate threat, so he would let the king handle them later.

chapters.title: Chapter 731: The Rewards
paragraphs: The moment Lord Yael spoke, the place became hushed, everyone paying attention to what came next.
"Before we start, I would like to point out that this year, we will be joined by a human who, like all of you, has met the requirements to participate.
If you see him among you, know that he is also after the same thing you all came here for. So if you don’t want to lose to him, be sure to give it your all."
The Half-Elves beside Kent turned and looked at him. Kent just smiled.

Lord Yael, who saw this, also smiled, knowing the competition was already decided. Knowing what Kent can do, he just wanted to see him in action yet again. He would never forget the way Kent handled the Hand and Kenji.
"That’s just by the way. The following announcement will be on rewards. Initially, the only reward worth having for this competition was a slot to enter the Flame Tower.
However, things are different now, and because of that, we need to make a few adjustments. However, don’t worry, the five slots are still available for you to take if you qualify in the end.
First, 1,204 of you applied. However, after the first round, 1,102 will be disqualified. This means most of you will only get to showcase your skill once.
But, while that is unfortunate, the king and the elders decided to make it worthwhile. The first 1,102 to wash out will receive a 1,000-year-old Soul Cleaning Berry."
"Wait, what... did the elder just say a thousand-year-old Soul Cleaning Berry?" one of the contestants, a young man with long blue hair, asked.
"I believe so," his friend, standing beside him, nodded.

"Wow, that is generous of them. A thousand-year-old Soul Cleaning Berry is something none of us can even start to think of getting. Even people like the elders can’t beat their chest and say they can easily get one.
I mean, a spirit fruit that can cleanse the soul and strengthen it isn’t something to underestimate at all. This is good."
Every contestant was happy to hear the reward awaiting the first to wash out. Most who knew they wouldn’t be able to do much were equally happy to hear that.
"The second round will also see 551 contestants washing out. For their reward, you will receive a Ruby-grade Ambrosia apple.
Those who know what an Ambrosia apple can do know it is an invaluable item. So be sure to do well and be part of the second badge of defeated contestants," he smiled.
Lord Yael could genuinely be an auctioneer, as evidenced by his ability to sell the reward as if it were a lifeline for everyone.

But knowing what an Ambrosia apple can do, most wanted to be part of the second batch. Of course, the greedy ones also wanted to continue, knowing from the third stage that the rewards would be much more generous.
"The Third round will be different; it could be that all of you will wash out, or half of the 551 will be washed out.
However, whichever the case, know that you will be walking away with a Dark Gold Grade Ambrosia apple and a 5,000-year-old Soul Cleansing Berry."
Of course, those who had planned to give up at the second stage now wanted to reach the third round to receive the reward. Lord Yael just smiled.

The fourth round will see only ten people remaining, meaning the final five will be determined at the fifth stage. But those who wash out at the fourth stage will get a Mythic Grade Ambrosia apple and a 10,000-year-old Soul Cleansing Berry.
And as for the five who won’t be getting a slot, you will receive an Ancient-grade Ambrosia apple and a 10,000-year-old Soul Cleansing Berry.
Also, you will receive a Tier 8 Innate Talent Awakening Pill from an alchemist that will be revealed at the end of the competition."
At this point, everyone was overjoyed to hear about the generous rewards awaiting them. Kent stood there looking at everyone with a smile on his face.
As it turned out, a goddess learning to become mortal was more generous than even a Saint. Vexthra made sure Kent completely turned the Half-Elves around before she left.
In her defense, the Soul Cleansing Berries were abundant in the Love Garden, so she wanted Kent to give as many as he could to the Half-Elves, since they didn’t really need them.

As for the Ambrosia apple, Kent could buy millions of them and not feel a dent in his wealth of Tower points. Now that the dungeon was giving him more than he could ask for, Kent wanted the whole world to take the Half-Elves seriously.
If he was going to make his name known, then this was a start...

"To the top five, you will, of course, get a slot to enter the Flame Tower. But aside from that, you will each receive an Immortal Grade Ambrosia Apple, a 10,000-year-old Soul Cleansing Berry, and a 10,000-year-old Spirit Grape Fruit.
On top of that, you will receive a Tier 9 Innate Talent Awakening Pill from this unknown alchemist."
The entire place went quiet when they heard Lord Yael’s words. The spies inside the arena started informing their leaders of this new development.
Naturally, that was how Kent wanted exposure. He knew getting into the sect wouldn’t guarantee him a chance to challenge the Pill Princess.
So, he planned to make his name known to many.
Words of a new genius alchemist emerging from the Half-Elf kingdom could shake the whole world.
Of course, this would make people start comparing him to the Pill Princess. Naturally, knowing how rude she was, as Shax had told him, Kent knew the moment she heard of him, he would be on her radar.
Then, when he finally got into the sect, one way or another, he would get what he wanted without even asking. Of course, the coming days would be a little chaotic, but he wasn’t worried...
"Before we start, there are a few important people I would like to introduce..."

chapters.title: Chapter 732: The Queen [Bonus]
paragraphs: The half-elves were happy, but their joy was about to reach a new height in the next few seconds.

"Everyone, this year, we are privileged to have King Thalirion gracing us with his presence. I am the one officiating the competition, but with him here, be assured that every judgment will be sound and just.
But he won’t be the only one here today. This year, we are also privileged to have with us Queen Jascia, our Queen."
The moment the queen was revealed, everyone fell quiet, watching as the queen, the king, and Princess Elowen were unveiled. They were seated in a spot where everyone could see them.
As they did, their cheers rang out, filling the arena. Queen Jascia smiled, waving at everyone.
Just like how everyone was happy to see her again, she was also happy to see them - her people.
Events like these competitions were something she held close to her heart. As a warrior who frequented the Ancient Battlefield of Parting, she was always returning with something to give away.
Almost every year, there were competitions, and many participants received generous rewards from her. Seeing her return was just too much for them to handle.
Their happiness was palpable. Some even started to shed tears seeing their queen, who nearly died saving their king, rise back up and look more energetic than ever.
Lord Yael looked around and then turned to Kent, giving him a nod that conveyed his thanks. Kent brought them great joy, one that would lift the spirit of many...
"Before we start, the queen would like to say a few words." Everyone quieted down to hear their queen for the first time in a thousand years...

"Everyone, it is good to see you all," Queen Jascia began with a smile. "It’s been a long time since we last saw each other. The reason, for those who don’t know, was because I was weak, and some idiot nearly claimed the life of the king.
But I survived, and he is dead, so what do we say..."
"THE EVIL WILL BE CRASHED BENEATH OUR FEET!"
Thousands shouted the queen’s slogan. It was her most famous phrase whenever she gave a speech or commanded warriors on the battlefield. So they were quite familiar with her words.

Queen Jascia smiled while the king shook his head, smiling at his wife’s unruly behavior. "I was told the long ears decided to push their luck while I was asleep. They even gave us five slots this year... I say we shouldn’t worry.

For now, the deed has already been done; however, it won’t be the same. We are equal to the elves in every right, so starting from the next three years, we will get 15 slots, the same number as the elves."
Cheers rang out yet again, everyone feeling their confidence return.
"Also, the five who will be making it inside the Flame Tower after the competition, I have something for you.
We must show the world that we are Hybrids, possessing the best of both worlds, so we can’t be inferior to others. We must show the world why we are Half-Elves.

Lastly, there will be another competition in five months, where the rewards will not pale in comparison to this. So be ready... those who can’t make it to the top five, you have five months to prepare, because trust me, things are about to get interesting very soon."
After saying her words, she leaned back with a smile on her face.
"We love you, Queen Jascia."
"You are the best, Queen Jascia."
"I heard she was amazing. Being here and hearing her for the first time... she is indeed the best."
"I know, right? I learned from my uncle that she was the only thing preventing the Elves from attacking us. He said whenever she appears on the battlefield, all hell breaks loose."

"My uncle said the same thing. He was once in her cohort when they explored the fractured island in the Ancient Battlefield of Parting... He said they managed to get into the Inner Area and killed a certain strange Beast, even obtaining a few treasures along the way.
He said the queen was a force of nature on the battlefield."

"She is amazing. Look at Mother, she is already itching to take her spear and enter the wild with her," Madea, one of the Half-Elves, everyone was banking on her to be part of the top five, said, looking in the direction of her mother, who was watching the queen, her happiness palpable.
Her mother was part of the queen’s main cohort back when she went exploring the Ancient Battlefield of Parting.
Everyone’s last contestant heard something amazing about the queen. They were all less than 100 years old, so this was their first time seeing her in person.
So to them, this was like seeing a true legend in the flesh...The queen is indeed a legend.
Lord Yael let everyone absorb the queen’s words before continuing.

"The first round will be an elimination-type round. You all have tokens with numbers on them. You will be matched with an opponent. When your numbers appear on the viewing formation board, it means it is your turn to fight."
Kent looked at his token, and the number engraved on it was 1204. ’Looks like I was the last addition. I wonder who I will be facing.’
"Of course, this is a competition meant to select the best. However, in the context of finding the best, we are actually looking for the best flame-type users.
This means from start to finish, all battles will be fought using just your Soul Flames. If other skills aside from the Soul Flame are employed, the formations will detect it and kick you out.
So be sure to use only your flame element and nothing else." Those who had registered were aware of this, so the announcement was intended for Kent.
He nodded slightly, eager to see what he would be going against and who would be his first opponent.
"Remember, death is not permanent... You will respawn outside the stage if you die from an attack. However, while death is not permanent, the pain will be felt, so do well not to die.
Also, don’t intentionally kill your fellow contestant if they surrender or if you see they can’t keep fighting anymore."
"That said, let the first rounds begin." The Viewing Formation Board showed the first contestants:
"Number 4 and 897." Two ladies walked onto the stage, and the rest of the group backed away.

chapters.title: Chapter 733: The Competition (1) [Bonus]
paragraphs: Kent stood on one side, surrounded by five Half-Elves, with a look of both excitement and weariness in their eyes. This was all they had been waiting for since the announcement was made months ago.
Numbers 4 and 897 stood in the arena, maintaining a distance of 30 meters between them.

"Lord Yael has already stated the rules. Only use fire and no other skills. This means you have to have a good handle on the flame you possess, and everything will be fine," the match official said, and the two ladies nodded.
"You may begin."
The moment he gave the command, the number 4 lady raised her hand, and flame surged, forming into a thick spear. She gestured forward, and the spear moved.
However, number 897 wasn’t standing there idly either. She formed a large shield made of fire and sent it flying toward the spear. The two collided, creating an infernal shockwave.
Cheers rang out, witnessing such a fierce start in a battle that was about to end. Just one clash, but the winner became obvious
Kent stood far from the battlefield, but the moment he saw the shield appear, he knew number 897 would win. Naturally, she had more control over her fire and was also brilliant.
When the lady formed the spear, for a split second, the shield lady made a subtle move with her leg. It was slight, but she managed to form the shield before it was noticeable.
That subtle move was a whole different skill on its own, one that manifested right when the spear and the shield met. The shockwave was the smoke screen needed to reveal that skill.
The moment the infernal shockwave rippled through the arena, the subtle leg movement became clear to everyone.
Number 897’s footwork shifted with precision, barely perceptible but enough to channel the flame energy coursing through her body.
From the edge of the fiery shield, a sudden burst of scorching fire spiraled outward in a twisting vortex — a concealed technique known as the "Ember Whirlwind."
The spinning flame cut through the smoky haze created by the impact, aiming directly at number 4.
Caught off guard by the rapid shift in attack, number 4 barely managed to raise her spear to defend.
The spear’s tip clashed against the swirling vortex, but the overwhelming heat and force were just too much. The spear melted and fragmented under the relentless blaze.
Before she could recover, the Ember Whirlwind surged forward, knocking her off balance and sending her flying out of the stage.
Cheers rang out for Number 897.
"I knew Ember’s technique was awesome, but to think she had mastered it to this stage already, she is a genius," one of the Half-Elves beside Kent said, shaking his head.
"She spent most of her time hunting inside the Flame Valley, so she got creative, and that clearly manifested just now."
Everyone was happy for Ember’s progress. The battle lasted less than a minute, but it was enough to demonstrate to everyone what she was capable of.
After Number 4 and Number 897 left the stage, Numbers 78 and 89 entered. This time, they were men. Their battle lasted for three minutes because they were able to counter each other’s attacks.

But in the end, Number 78 won. More battles happened after that. Within four hours, over 400 battles took place. Most of the battles ended in under a minute, considering how creative some of the fighters had become with their attacks.
Eventually, it was the turn of one of the geniuses everyone knew of... Madea. They said she was the genius among the younger generation...
(Number 1003 vs. Madea)

Madea is a beautiful, brown-haired lady with perfect facial features and an athletic body. She has brown eyes and is clad in brown, form-fitting leather armor. Naturally, that armor accentuated her shape, revealing to everyone that she was both a genius and a seducer.
She walked calmly and stood opposite a young man who held a spear. The moment he saw Madea, he smiled weakly.
"Let’s have a good fight, big sister Madea."
Madea smiled and nodded.
"Begin."

The moment the signal was given, the young man moved, flames lighting his spear as he spun it. When he got close to Madea, he stabbed forward, sending a replica of the spear made purely from flame at her.
However, the brown-eyed lady smiled and waved her hand, sending out a spear of her own. The two collided, creating a shockwave.

However, Madea’s spear was much more robust, so after a few struggles, the young man’s spear was obliterated. Madea’s spear surged and exploded in front of the young man’s face, knocking him out of the arena.
The battle was over before it even began.
More battles followed afterwards. Eventually, the top geniuses had their chance to display why they were the best in Elarion.
Kent remained seated, watching them all. To him, taking out his sword to use the flame with it would be too much.
However, aside from the Elemental Overlord, where he could conjure any beast out of his flame element with a slash of his sword, he didn’t have any other flame skills.

Over the past hours, after watching over 300 battles, Kent was concerned that utilizing any of his skills would discourage others. So, he was left to decide what to do. Which skill to use that won’t turn out to be an overkill...
Eventually, a smile appeared on his face...
’During the Chaos battle back then, one of the Great Family heads used a flame skill to manifest weapons. I guess I will do that.’
After a few back-and-forth moments, he arrived at a solution—an unusual one, but one that came from the Primordial Era.
More battles happened.
Exactly five hours into the battle, Kent’s number was called. He walked toward the stage with calm steps. He was paired with a handsome Half-Elf named Gijion—one handsome fellow with big dreams.
The moment Kent stepped onto the stage, everyone’s eyes were on him. Queen Jascia’s eyes narrowed, wanting to see if what her husband told her about Kent was right.
Of course, the king just sat there, knowing full well that the human his wife and daughter were paying attention to was a monster in human form.
Kent faced his opponent, who, just like him, also held no weapon. ’Sorry, friend, but you will be washing out today.’ Kent said inwardly
"Begin."
The moment the command was given, Gijion moved, and Kent raised his hand and snapped his fingers. Up in the air, a hundred golden flame arrows appeared, immediately halting Gijion in his tracks.
Everyone gasped.

chapters.title: Chapter 734: The Competition (2)
paragraphs: Gijion came to a halt, his eyes widening as he stared at Kent, as if he had seen some kind of monster. Kent, on the other hand, stood there looking at Gijion with a frown.
"What happened? Why aren’t you moving?" Kent asked.
Gijion looked at him, then at the hundred flame arrows, and a sigh escaped his lips.
"I accept defeat," Gijion said with another sigh and smiled.

Looking at the number of arrows, each about 2 meters long and all aimed at him, everyone in the arena knew there was no way he would be able to defend, even if just two of those arrows shot toward him.
’Did I go too far?’ Kent wondered. To him, conjuring just 100 arrows was the basic level he could go when the true form of the skill was put into consideration.
The skill he used was the same one used against ’Chaos during his battle to liberate the people of Lumen from the tyranny of the three Great Families.
But back then, the person conjured thousands of arrows, daggers, swords, spears, and various other types of weapons. They even added Spiritual Qi to the mix, making the true attack much more deadly.
Kent merely used 100 arrows, and the young man simply couldn’t understand how a person could harness that much flame energy into a single attack.
Queen Jascia watched Kent’s display with a slightly widened expression.
"He is dangerous. That is for sure. Considering that he is able to form this many arrows made purely out of fire, he must have a large pool of soul essence."
King Thalirion smiled and nodded. "I’ve already told you he is no simple person. Adding him to the competition is already too much for someone of his caliber."
"I can see that now. The question now is, is that his limit, or can he do more than that?"

While the queen was coming to terms with what to think of Kent, the man in question put out the fire arrows and walked out onto the stage under the watchful eyes of everyone competing and the audience.
"He is a monster," one said, watching Kent walk away.
"I guess this answers our question of who will be making our top five lose a spot. I just pray he doesn’t meet someone like Madea or Norion. If he were to defeat them, I would be pissed."
"Me too. However, you can’t deny... his joining our side will indeed raise our standard if he were to enter the sect."

"That is indeed true. Though he is a human, he will be entering the sect under the banner of the Half-Elves. With his display just now, I have no doubt he will become someone worth paying attention to when he gets into the sect."
"Then I guess he’s taking one spot; it isn’t too bad."
Slowly, people started to adapt to this new change.

At first, no one knew anything about Kent, the only human in the competition. However, now they seemed to start seeing his strength from just a single display, and looking at what he was able to show, they all didn’t seem to think Kent taking a spot would be a bad thing.
If anything, they were thrilled to have him among them.
Of course, this acceptance stemmed from the fact that the guardianship Kent held over them compelled them to like him rather than resent him.
Being a guardian of a race means their safety is in his hands. Kent would have to travel millions of miles to save them if, one day in the future, they found themselves in trouble.
So, having that much responsibility must also have some perks, and one of them is the love they are showing him.
They saw him as one of their own, and Kent also felt deeply within his heart how much he would do and how far he would go for them.
Just like how he would rain hellfire on anyone who dared touch Li Hua, he would do the same for the Foxkins and the Half-Elves simply because he was their guardian.
After Kent walked off the stage, a few more battles happened before the first round of the competition ended. It took six hours, but every last one inside the arena had fun.
But 1,102 had washed out, and no one frowned or cried. They had already expected this outcome when they registered, so their failure was received in good faith.

Then again, walking away with a 1,000-year-old Soul Cleansing Berry wasn’t too bad. If they were to purchase them from the Fox kingdom, since they were the ones who had such a type of spirit fruit, it would have cost them no less than a hundred million spirit stones.
So this was good.
Lord Yael appeared again to address the 1,102 remaining.
"That was a good first round. But unfortunately, we are still not close to having our top five. We will then proceed to a second round, which is also an elimination-type round.
Just as before, the pairing is random, so be prepared when your number is revealed on the board. Also, like with the first round, only flame-type skills—"
Everyone nodded.
"On that note, we will start the second round now. And may the 551 who would qualify for the third round have a good fight."
The first battle was between 28 and 560.
Just as before, it was a pure display of flame manipulation, one in which everyone showcased their understanding of the flame.
Number 28 won, but it was a fierce battle that lasted only two minutes. By the time the battle was over, everyone realized some people had hidden their prowess in the first round.
This became apparent as more battles happened.
Even the top five everyone was rooting for this time had to put in some effort before they managed to defeat their opponents.

Kent realized that perhaps this wasn’t all too bad. He scammed every last one of them, and aside from a few who were 98 years old, all those performing remarkably well were under 90 years old, meaning most of them would have two more chances to enter the Flame Tower before they turned 100 years old.
Of course, he knew that next time, when they got 15 slots like their queen promised them, the Supreme Immortal Sect would start to see an influx of Half-Elves in the coming years.
Kent would make sure of that. He had the means, the resources, and the tools to make them rise through the ranks quickly, so he planned to do just that.
As the guardian, he knew the stronger they got, the more soul essence he would receive.
After more battles occurred, Kent’s number appeared. He was paired against another dude. They walked onto the stage and faced each other 20 meters apart.
