chapters.title: Chapter 745: Back To The Flame Valley [Bonus]
paragraphs: Kent was surprised when the eight Half-Elves managed to awaken the soul flame. He expected them to do it within a week, but they did it in three days.
Of course, he knew that the moment they consumed the Spirit Grape Fruit and the Ambrosia Apple, their comprehension speeds increased. But three days were just too much.
However, Kent also learned something new: that to consume the ambrosia apple easily, it is necessary to consume the Spirit Grape Fruit first.
That was why they used only a few hours to finish absorbing the two fruits and awaken their actual soul flames—every last one of them.
However, while they managed to awaken their soul flames, Princess Elowen awakened a rather unique flame known as the Phoenix Ice Flame.
It was an Ice flame, one that burns with absolute coldness.
It was unique and challenging to cultivate.
Consuming the spirits of the flames from Flame Valley would only improve her soul flame by 10%. However, she didn’t need to do much, considering she came out with a Tier 7 soul flame.

This means her soul flame is already a Mystical grade flame, so she doesn’t need to level up now. The only reason she is coming with them is to train and gain experience while refining her skills to a certain level.
Unlike Kent and the other four, who would enter the tower before entering the sect, she will join the sect with an invitation and participate in the exams immediately.
A few kilometers from the valley, Kent stopped the carriage, and they alighted.
"This place always creeps me out when I see it," Norion said, looking at the vast, scorching land waiting for them.

"Same here. The last time I was here, not only did those scums from the Supreme Immortal Sect steal my kill, they even got a flame spirit from it. I nearly died, but they got to walk away with my hard-earned kill."
Elia, the other girl who qualified to enter the Flame Tower, said. She has glowing white hair and serene blue eyes.
Kent listened to their complaints and smiled.
"Don’t worry, if we meet anyone from the sect with an ulterior motive, we will be the ones doing the stealing. That said, I doubt they will be reckless inside the Core Region."
"Are we really going to hunt in the Core Region?" Cyran asked, recalling how they nearly died even in the outer reaches of the Inner Region.
"That is where the big guns are. If we want to enter the Flame Tower and Sect with blazing colors, then we have to take the risk now. Trust me, this is good for all of you."
Kent’s plan may sound noble, but he didn’t come to the Core Region of the Flame Valley just to help the Half-Elves. His main plan was to help them, but also create monsters out of them.
He wanted that so that in the future, even when they part ways, he will continue to benefit from their exploitation.
Kent has unlocked a new feature called [Guardian Hand].
This feature awards him ten slots to add ten people he deems fit from any race he takes under his protection.
All those he adds to the Guardian Hand will be like an extension of his role as a guardian. This means they will become people who will act in his stead when he is away.
But it goes beyond that. These new people he added to his Guardian Hand are like a Wi-Fi connection. Whenever they are in the midst of people, they will be able to siphon their soul essence to him.

In other words, simply being around people allows Kent to temporarily connect his soul thread to them and absorb their soul essence. Of course, it won’t affect those whose soul essence he will be taking.

So, aside from having people to act as guards, he now has people who, one day, if they continue to rise, will be able to gain more from them. Kent knew that to create a universe, he needed to have more than enough soul essence.
This guardian hand is another way to spread his reach on the soul essence.
It was one of those features of the tower he had never known existed but now needed. Ten Guardian Hands from every race he added to his guardian tower meant ten more channels he could use to grow.
And with his infinite amount of resources to make them stronger, Kent knew his growth would be endless if he played his cards right.
"Let’s go. We have a lot to do and limited time to get it done, so we’d better start early." They nodded, and Kent started moving while they followed.
"Errh, Kent, aren’t you going to wear armor?" Arion asked, and Kent smiled.
"I don’t need one."
"Why, are you like a body cultivator or something?" Norion asked in a slightly amused tone, not knowing he was about to learn something new about Kent.
"As a matter of fact, I am a Diamond Body Cultivator," Kent grinned.
All eight half-elves looked at him with calm expressions. A few seconds later, Princess Elowen smiled, "Are you sure you are 21 years old?"
"I had my 21st birthday a few months back."

They could only watch him walk in front with their thoughts hidden in their minds. But every last one of them could only hope that by the time they separated from Kent, they would be able to grow to even half his strength.
After moving through the Outer Region without encountering any flame beasts, they stepped into the Inner Region.
’Alright, Tower, I need the hot spots like we discussed yesterday.’ Kent asked the tower to create a map of the Flame Valley and locate where the beasts with cores and flame spirits were.
They are the dangerous ones, so he wanted to use them to train the half-elves while earning their keep. Thankfully, the Tower was more than capable of doing that.
⟦I managed to locate three sections in the inner section where flame spirits can be harvested. Additionally, I discovered a flame-type herb known as Sunlight Poison Flower.
Consuming it will enhance your poison resistance and strengthen your soul flame as well. Of course, it is guarded by powerful Flame Beasts⟧.

Kent smiled and turned to his team after learning all about the three sections. "We will be exploring the east first. When passing through a week ago, I sensed some powerful auras there. After that, we have three more stops to make before entering the Core Region.
"Aside, Princess Elowen, you all have Tier 4 flames, so this will be a good hunt to strengthen them."
They nodded and started moving eastward.

chapters.title: Chapter 746: First Hunt & More About The Sect
paragraphs: Boom.

The body of a large scorpion flame beast slammed into the ground after Cyran pierced its sixth eye with an arrow. A large crater was created where the body landed. Though not tired, the Eight-Half Elves sigh.
"That was the last of them," Dorren, a handsome young man and one of the four Half-Elves who would be entering the Flame Tower, said, sheathing his sword.

Kent smiled and jumped down from a tree he had stood on while the Half-Elves fought. All around the five-mile radius, there were seven bodies of flame beasts, the strongest being the Six Wooden Leg Spider.
It had already refined its core six times, and the strength it packed wasn’t something the eight Half-Elves had expected.
Thankfully, they had the Princess to help tilt the odds in their favor. She had already refined her core six times, and on the last—
Even so, she had to press on hard before they took down the spider.
Kent, who had seen the battle from start to finish, knew that if this was the finest of a suppressed race, then this world surely held some potential—one he could exploit for his gain.
"That was a good fight. However, you all need to learn how to fight individually against all odds and as a team," Kent said, collecting the seventh flame spirit they had acquired.

"Arion, Cyran, and Helyra are already a team, so they were able to coordinate well, but the rest of you need to adapt. Of course, I saw the coordination in your last battle, and while it isn’t perfect, I know things will be different soon."
They nodded, and Kent produced seven flames. He checked them all, but he already had aspects of every last flame they had farmed.
The moment the Half-Elves saw the colored flames appear in front of Kent, smiles appeared on their faces, wiping away any form of fatigue they may have felt.

"You’ve all done well, so here is your gain." He gave them each a flame that complemented their soul flames. "The reason for having your own soul flame is the ability to inherit the aspects of the flame spirits you absorb.

"For example, the flame spirit that Madea is about to devour has an aspect of illusion. That means the moment she devours it, the illusion aspect will be inherited by her soul flame, which will allow her to use it with her soul flame, and as an archer, she can utilize the illusion with her arrows."
Hearing Kent’s words made them feel even more powerful, for as he had said, they were going to grow endlessly with their soul flames.
For now, they could only hope that by the time they left the Flame Valley, their soul flames would reach Tier 7.
Kent had already noticed something intriguing — his Chaos Flame.
When the Half-Elves awakened their soul flames, he felt how hungry his Chaos Flame had become. He only felt this hunger when he fed on one powerful flame while passing through the Core Region.

This hunger was like a call, showing how much his soul flame yearned to consume the soul flames of others. Unfortunately, aside from the Half-Elves that he planned to use as an extension of his influence, the others didn’t have natural soul flames.
But the same could not be said for the sect.
Kent knew that, one way or another, he would soon be devouring more powerful soul flames.
"Let’s go," Kent said, and they started moving. Their next destination is waiting for them with powerful flame beasts ready to devour them.
"So, what do you guys know about the sect?" Kent saw this as a nice opportunity to pick their brains on what to expect from the sect.
The eight Half-Elves looked at each other before turning to Princess Elowen, since she was the oldest and most knowledgeable among them.
She sighed and began to speak, "Just like you, I don’t know much, but I happen to have the privilege of being the daughter of a king, so naturally, I know some things.

According to what my dad told me, the Supreme Immortal Sect is the strongest in this world. He mentioned something about the Planetary Alliance, where many medium-sized worlds in the same planetary system come together to form an alliance.
Of course, he doesn’t know how many planets are in this alliance, but he said that more than 50 planets can come together to form an alliance. Any less and it will be called a sub-sector alliance.
And this world is represented by the Supreme Immortal sect."
"You know, for someone who doesn’t know much, you sure know a lot," Kent said, already thankful he had someone like a princess in his company for the time being.
Princess Elowen smiled. "Well, I was desperate to find ways to save my mom, so I asked a lot of questions and found out about some things.

Unfortunately, to learn more, I would have to join the sect. But I know enough to say the Supreme Immortal Sect rules this world. They are the strength, defenders of this world, and they represent this world in both the sub-sector and the Planetary Alliance.
They have the resources to grow and nurture talents. So, in case you think this world is boring, perhaps getting into the sect will show you more."
"I guess I can’t wait to enter the sect and find out for myself."
Kent smiled, knowing things were getting interesting now.
He also understood that the Hand was perhaps a small fry now... his focus should be on the sect.
Of course, knowing the Hand was planning to open the doors and unleash the race of the apocalypse on everyone was something he had to fix.
But hearing there was a much bigger alliance housing many worlds, he knew his horizon had to broaden.
’I have been roaming in the wrong pool. If I play my cards right, my name will soon shake both high and immortal worlds.’

Ever since the Paragon gave him the Soul Universe soul technique, he had started to look for ways to grow stronger much faster. For some reason, he felt this soul universe was something he couldn’t ignore.
He knew that when it comes down to it, his ultimate trump card will be the soul Universe, and making it grow much stronger now should be something he wouldn’t take for granted.
If anything, Kent knew housing thousands of asteroids in his soul would surely create the right amount of chaos needed to handle the most potent threat there is.
’Thousands of medium worlds, huh. It will undoubtedly be a wild journey. One I will remember forever.’
Kent grinned, almost feeling the chaos seeping into his bones. That madness Chaos felt was now a part of him, and he began to feel it.

If the leaders of the sect knew a madman was coming into their sect, perhaps they would do everything they could to ensure he never entered their premises. But then again, the Chaos Dragon cannot be held back.
One way or another, Kent would find his way into the sect, and if they don’t take care, perhaps their fear would be realized.
Soon, Kent and his team reached the second location the Tower had mapped and started their second massacre of the day.

sentences.text: Boom.
The body of a large scorpion flame beast slammed into the ground after Cyran pierced its sixth eye with an arrow.
A large crater was created where the body landed.
Though not tired, the Eight-Half Elves sigh.
"That was the last of them," Dorren, a handsome young man and one of the four Half-Elves who would be entering the Flame Tower, said, sheathing his sword.
Kent smiled and jumped down from a tree he had stood on while the Half-Elves fought.
All around the five-mile radius, there were seven bodies of flame beasts, the strongest being the Six Wooden Leg Spider.
It had already refined its core six times, and the strength it packed wasn’t something the eight Half-Elves had expected.
Thankfully, they had the Princess to help tilt the odds in their favor.
She had already refined her core six times, and on the last—
Even so, she had to press on hard before they took down the spider.
Kent, who had seen the battle from start to finish, knew that if this was the finest of a suppressed race, then this world surely held some potential—one he could exploit for his gain.
"That was a good fight.
However, you all need to learn how to fight individually against all odds and as a team," Kent said, collecting the seventh flame spirit they had acquired.
"Arion, Cyran, and Helyra are already a team, so they were able to coordinate well, but the rest of you need to adapt.
Of course, I saw the coordination in your last battle, and while it isn’t perfect, I know things will be different soon."
They nodded, and Kent produced seven flames.
He checked them all, but he already had aspects of every last flame they had farmed.
The moment the Half-Elves saw the colored flames appear in front of Kent, smiles appeared on their faces, wiping away any form of fatigue they may have felt.
"You’ve all done well, so here is your gain." He gave them each a flame that complemented their soul flames.
"The reason for having your own soul flame is the ability to inherit the aspects of the flame spirits you absorb.
"For example, the flame spirit that Madea is about to devour has an aspect of illusion.

That means the moment she devours it, the illusion aspect will be inherited by her soul flame, which will allow her to use it with her soul flame, and as an archer, she can utilize the illusion with her arrows."
Hearing Kent’s words made them feel even more powerful, for as he had said, they were going to grow endlessly with their soul flames.
For now, they could only hope that by the time they left the Flame Valley, their soul flames would reach Tier 7.
Kent had already noticed something intriguing — his Chaos Flame.
When the Half-Elves awakened their soul flames, he felt how hungry his Chaos Flame had become.
He only felt this hunger when he fed on one powerful flame while passing through the Core Region.
This hunger was like a call, showing how much his soul flame yearned to consume the soul flames of others.
Unfortunately, aside from the Half-Elves that he planned to use as an extension of his influence, the others didn’t have natural soul flames.
But the same could not be said for the sect.
Kent knew that, one way or another, he would soon be devouring more powerful soul flames.

Their next destination is waiting for them with powerful flame beasts ready to devour them.
"So, what do you guys know about the sect?" Kent saw this as a nice opportunity to pick their brains on what to expect from the sect.
The eight Half-Elves looked at each other before turning to Princess Elowen, since she was the oldest and most knowledgeable among them.

He mentioned something about the Planetary Alliance, where many medium-sized worlds in the same planetary system come together to form an alliance.
Of course, he doesn’t know how many planets are in this alliance, but he said that more than 50 planets can come together to form an alliance.
Any less and it will be called a sub-sector alliance.
And this world is represented by the Supreme Immortal sect."
"You know, for someone who doesn’t know much, you sure know a lot," Kent said, already thankful he had someone like a princess in his company for the time being.

Unfortunately, to learn more, I would have to join the sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 747: Red Mountain
paragraphs: "That was the last of them." Kent smiled and walked toward the body of a flame tiger. He took the flame spirit and handed it over to Dorren.
They had just completed the third mapped zone and shared the flames with them.

The second zone had ten beasts, and at that time, Kent had to help them. But the third had only seven, so he made them handle it. Thankfully, with their soul flames already at the 5th Tier, their attacks were much more powerful.
Of course, they are good warriors with versatile skills. Dorren uses the sword just like Arion and Norion. Cyran uses the bow like Madea and Princess Elowen.
Kent was surprised when he saw her pull out a bow. Of course, he knew the elves mainly were archers, so he didn’t look too shocked. As for Helyra, she is a mage just like Elia.
So they have some good skills up their sleeves.
Judging by how they fought, Kent knew they had each faced some form of danger, and that made them grow as individuals. This made shaping them into monsters easy.
He had already started to see some changes. Of course, his main training plan will be handled by his legion, but for now, he is giving them the basics.
So far, he has seen some progress because they managed to handle the seven beasts more easily. But Kent knew that the moment they entered the core region, things would change.
This meant he had to get involved personally.
"We have just one more stop to make before entering the core region." They nodded and flew away, heading to their final destination in the inner region.
They flew toward a mountain standing several kilometers high.
"Isn’t that the Red Mountain?" Cyran asked when the mountain came into view, even from several miles back.
"Yes, that is the Red Mountain," Norion answered, looking slightly weary.
"I heard of it too, but never dared to come here. Now, looking at it, I know I made the right decision." Elia smiled, looking at the mountain looming close as they moved.

"You indeed made the right decision. I learned that a powerful beast is living in this mountain. I learned from the adventurers guild that coming within two miles of this mountain is to ask for death... now we are getting closer." Dorren couldn’t help but shake a little.
"Uhm, Kent, what are we doing here?" Princess Elowen asked.
"You will see in a bit," Kent smiled as he sped up. Naturally, he wasn’t looking to make them fight whatever would be coming out. However, he wanted them to feel the pressure and the danger.
As expected, the moment they got within two meters of the mountain, it shuddered, and a terrifying pressure descended on them. They all came to a halt and then landed on the scorching hot ground.
"Who dares evade my domain?" A voice came from the mountain, causing the half-elves to shudder.
Kent smiled, feeling something new.

This pressure wasn’t like the pressure from the other beasts he had killed. This one, though primal, had some refinement to it. It was as if it belonged to someone who had cultivated with purpose and understanding.
And while he knew this pressure belonged to a beast, he knew this one had an innate talent like the Beastkins he had met.
This meant the beast speaking was more than it appeared. Kent intended to find out more...
"We didn’t intend to intrude into the senior’s domain. Sorry if we offend you," Kent spoke, wanting to see if his suspicion was justified.
The pressure remained, causing the half-elves to pale. Of course, the pressure from a beast that had already completed seven refinings was no easy target.
And judging by how powerful it felt, Kent knew the pressure was coming from a beast that had long refined all seven cores, perhaps hundreds of years ago.
However, Kent also wanted to know more about the beast before making any drastic decision. Thankfully, the response he gave the beast took the pressure off.

"Leave," the beast spoke, and Kent nodded. However, he didn’t move, which caused the half-elves to wonder what was going through his mind. A few seconds later, the pressure returned, but this time, with a presence.
When the figure appeared in the air, all eight half-elves dropped to their knees. Even Kent felt the pressure. However, instead of feeling pressured, he smiled.
"No need to become hostile, senior. I didn’t come here to fight you. You can treat this meeting as a fateful one because I believe we are destined to meet."
The figure was a man with long red hair, around fifty years old, considering that based on his appearance, he had long passed the youthful age.
But he was packing some muscle, and judging by the horns on his head and the large tail behind him, even fear would cause one to run away at the sight of him.
He was close to three meters tall, and in his hand, an axe so big that Kent knew it would take considerable strength to wield.

The beast of a man was a flame drake in the process of becoming a dragon, and judging by the pressure it emitted and the strength coursing through him, he had already reached the stage most dragons couldn’t dream of.
The only thing left now was to take that final step and become a dragon.
Kent suspected this phenomenon when he felt the pressure. This gave him a reason not to attack immediately, for he wanted this beast on his side.
Killing him would be a waste.
Of course, it would be a good fight for Kent, since though he knew he could trounce him, the drake, staring at him, was no easy target
The drake, now in his human form, looked down at Kent with an expression filled with primal fury. However, deep within his soul, he knew attacking the human wouldn’t end well for him.

And as a beast who was halfway to becoming a dragon, he knew dying now was not an option. But aside from that, for some reason, he felt Kent was no human... not even a monster. The human staring at him was a beast unlike any other.
He felt it, and now, he would have to make a decision.
’Be happy, Uncle Drake, the meeting today is a great fortune that not many beasts could afford.
And since I can’t show that I’m a dragon because I plan to put humans back on the map, I will need your help to handle the dragons.’
Kent smiled cheerfully, knowing he would be getting the best of both worlds regardless of what decision the drake made.

chapters.title: Chapter 748: Uncle Drake [Bonus]
paragraphs: The drake continued to stare at Kent for three whole minutes. However, while that is a long time to maintain his pressure, the half-elves soon began adapting to it. Kent noted this and could only smile inwardly.
The drake fought all kinds of internal battles, figuring out whether or not to attack. However, after a few more minutes, he withdrew his aura.
"You can leave. But be sure you don’t come back again, for I won’t be merciful next time." With that, the drake turned to leave.
However, Kent didn’t allow him.
"You are looking to become a dragon, right? What if I can help you become one within a week?" The drake halted in his tracks and turned sharply to Kent, looking with eyes filled with fury.
"I have changed my mind. You all can die." The drake started charging an attack.
"I know you are guarding the Sunlight Poison flower, hoping that by absorbing it, you will finally take the next step to becoming a dragon.
However, that won’t work. The flower is not strong enough to awaken the latent dragon blood in your system.
However, I have more than enough ways to give you what you want. I have a treasure that can help you. So killing me is a waste to you..."

The half-elves started sweating, showing they weren’t having a good time being under the killing intent of a being halfway to becoming a dragon, who, from the look of things, wouldn’t pale in comparison to someone like the Crystal Dragon King.

Being under the pressure of the drake was manageable, but his aura filled with killing intent wasn’t one they could handle. However, standing behind Kent also made them feel like they still had a lifeline.
And they did. The drake felt the sincerity in Kent’s words, so the attack never came. But the aura remained.
"Are you playing with me, boy?" the drake asked, but Kent shook his head like the boy he was. Looking at the imposing height of the drake, Kent was barely an ant before him.
"I don’t lie, Uncle Drake. I am the most sincere person you will ever meet." Kent took a Spirit Grape Fruit and threw it at the drake, who caught it.

"I know you are knowledgeable, so you can tell what that is. Even if you don’t know its name, you can feel the energy it contains. So tell me, do you believe I have what it takes to make you a dragon?"
It wasn’t a matter of whether he had the means or not.

The drake was present when the Spirit Grapefruit was auctioned many years ago. He caught wind of it and knew that something of such value was something he could use. However, back then, he couldn’t do much because he wasn’t privileged like most were.
It was that frustration that drove him to the Flame Valley, and luckily for him, he managed to locate the flower that he had been guarding for the past 300 years.
Many came after it but met a rather agonizing end.
But today, Uncle Drake wasn’t in the right mindset to attack, for he was offered something he wanted, something he had been looking for ever since he sensed a trace of dragon blood in his body.
This also meant that if he wanted to take that step, he had to trust Kent. But the question now was whether Kent was trustworthy.
Thankfully, Kent had the means to help him, for the tower had already made him aware of what had to be done.

"Look, I would be lying if I said my coming here is noble. I came here for the flower you are guarding with the intent to take it, regardless of who is protecting it. This means I came here to kill you.

And before you think it, know that I do have the means to kill you. I can kill you in two moves: the first to dismantle your defense and the next to behead you. Of course, I can also command you to die, and you will obey.

However, the moment I set my sight on you, I knew we were destined to meet. That is why I will spare you. That said, you becoming a dragon is something I want, so why don’t we sit down and talk it over?
By the way, I am Kent."

It was a subtle way of threatening someone without making it look obvious. Kent made sure the drake knew the odds and why he wouldn’t be enforcing them. But then again, he had done it for his own conscience.
This way, if the drake were the kind who couldn’t be reasoned with, he would attack, and Kent would have to kill him and then evolve him when he becomes Veera’s or Yi Lai’s undead soldier.
Either way, he would get what he wanted. So there was no loss for him in this scenario.
"Follow me."
Kent smiled and flew after the drake, who landed atop the towering mountain. The half-elves followed him, and soon they were standing inside a lava pool.
Kent felt his resistance rising just by being there, and while he was sure the flame energy here was strong, he knew that raising his resistance too high would either take time or be impossible.

Sitting at the center of this lava pool was a red flower radiating both infernal energy and poison essence. Kent sensed he could use this flower to feed his soul flame instead, because while he wasn’t even close to it, his soul flame was already eager to devour it.
He knew one way or another, he would be getting the flower.
They sat down, and the drake stared at Kent as if wanting to devour him. Kent just smiled while his companions tensed. Of course, Kent knew what he wanted was already in the bag, so he relaxed.
"Eat the fruit I gave you, and absorb the energy. It should take less than 30 minutes for the energy to be absorbed into your body.
We will continue after you are done." Uncle Drake looked at Kent for a few seconds, then threw the grape into his mouth and ate it.
A few seconds after consuming the fruit, his soul, which had been at the peak of the Tier 11 stage, broke through to the 12th Tier.
This shocked the drake greatly, but he continued to absorb the remaining energy for twenty minutes before he opened his eyes.
"You are almost there, but first, why don’t we take care of something vital?"

chapters.title: Chapter 749: Beast Companion [Bonus]
paragraphs: "First of all, before I can help you... You must sign a contract with me."
"Absolutely not. I wouldn’t become your slave just for power. If it is going to take death for me to tell you that, then let’s fight." Uncle Drake clearly misunderstood Kent. But who could blame him?
Most beast tamers are slave masters, for the beasts under them are either forced into submission or are handed contracts that don’t benefit them like they do the beast master.
However, Kent is different; his contracts essentially require him to ensure that every one of his companions is taken care of by him.

Of course, they will provide him with Spiritual Qi, soul essence, skill upgrade points, and tower points. But that is just something trivial in the long run. After all, Kent already has three races under his belt, giving him all he wants.
So, looking at this offer with a critical eye, Uncle Drake has more to gain than even Kent.
However, Kent is a no-nonsense guy, so he already anticipated this response, for that is how he would respond if someone he couldn’t kill asked for said contract.
"Relax. This contract isn’t for you to become my slave. I hate slavery, so don’t worry about me turning you into one."
"Then what contract are you talking about?"
"The kind that will allow you to grow unimpeded. I’m not sure if you’re already aware, but this world is just the beginning of a cultivation journey.
There are high worlds, immortal worlds, and god worlds out there that have beings stronger than you can imagine.
Getting there is hard, but not for me. With a snap of my fingers, I can take you there. However, I don’t think we need to discuss that now.
Please be aware that signing this contract with me is in your best interest. It would allow me to help you better."
Be it Uncle Drake or the eight Half-Elves, they were all in awe of what Kent had just said. They wanted to doubt him, but after seeing what he could do, doubting him was no longer an option.
"Fine. But if you deceive me, I will find ways to kill you, even if it is the last thing I do."
Kent just smirked and extended his hand, forming an orb that flew and entered Uncle Drake’s forehead. The moment the orb entered, his eyes widened.
"Is that..." Uncle Drake wanted to say something, but he couldn’t come up with the words.
Kent smiled. "Yes. That is the first form of a cultivation technique meant for dragons. It is a God-grade technique when in the first form.
When the next four forms have been added, the grade will rise to the Celestial grade.
Of course, you need years to comprehend this form, but trust me, every single step you make will raise your strength to a whole new level."
"This is just too..."
"Awesome. I know I am that awesome, no need to tell me." Kent laughed and then added his classic line, "Never doubt me."
Uncle Drake froze in his seat, not because of Kent’s shamelessness but because of what he had just received. It was just too much for him to comprehend.
The fact that Kent had just given him a God-grade Dragon cultivation technique was just too unbelievable to the point that moving his fingers wasn’t possible.
Kent just smirked at his expression, knowing there was no way in hell this man would ever doubt him again. In fact, the contract was just his way of adding him to the Legion Tower.
The technique was just a way of welcoming Uncle Drake into the family of the Chaos Dragon.
"Now that we’ve got that out of the way, you must get started with becoming a dragon." Kent produced two more fruits. One was an Immortal-grade Ambrosia apple, and the other was a Flame Dragon Fruit.
He got the dragon fruit from the tower store for ten million tower points, so naturally, it was an invaluable treasure if it were to be auctioned.
But he now has more tower points than he needed, so he just gave them to him as if it were nothing.
"The golden fruit will raise your spirit root to a whole new level. When that is done, you can consume the red fruit. It is a dragon fruit, so right after eating, the process will start."
Uncle Drake nodded.
Kent stood up and walked closer to the Sunlight Poison fruit. "I will send you to a place where you will have the privacy to cultivate.

Time flies faster there, so to you, it will take a couple of months, but to us, it will be a couple of days, perhaps a week. But the next time you see the outside world, you will be a full-fledged dragon like you wanted."
Uncle Drake nodded again, then vanished.
"Where did he go?" Dorren asked, staring at Uncle Drake, who had sat just a moment ago.
"I sent him to a private domain where he will have the peace to cultivate in a more peaceful setting."
"I want to go there and cultivate too," Elia said, but Kent just smiled, "Later. For now, we have to farm for flame spirits." They nodded, and Kent uprooted the flower.

A wave of energy washed over him as he gazed at the flower. It had fiery red petals, eight of them, each holding so much energy that Kent knew absorbing it would be of great help. After admiring it for a few more seconds, he lit his golden flame and devoured the flower.
Messages appeared the moment the flower was devoured.
⟦Your Soul Flame has devoured a large amount of Flame and Poison Energy.⟧
⟦The Quality of your Soul Flame has been upgraded from Tier 6 ↠ Tier 7⟧
⟦You have absorbed a large amount of Fire Energy.⟧
⟦Your Weak Flame Resistance Grows Stronger.⟧
⟦You have absorbed a large amount of Poison Energy. Your bloodline is activated.⟧
⟦Your bloodline has devoured the Poison.⟧
⟦Congratulations, you have achieved Poison Resistance.⟧
⟦Current Resistance: Weak⟧
’Well, that was unexpected but welcome.’ Kent’s smile, feeling newfound strength, washed through his body. His main objective for coming to the valley had been realized.
This means he can now focus on other things.
"Let’s go." Kent started flying away while the eight Elves followed. Princess Elowen wanted to ask something, but she kept it to herself after some consideration.
For now, she would just remain on the side and follow all Kent had to say, for that was her main objective for coming to the valley. The other minor issues would be handled later.
⟦I have mapped out 12 locations in the core region with a large number of flame beasts. However, be warned, the locations house some of the most terrifying beasts you will meet in a medium world.⟧
’I guess it is a good thing I brought backup,’ Kent laughed inwardly.
With his strength, fearing anything in a medium world would be very hard. Perhaps there are beings he would struggle against, but dying to them isn’t one of those.

chapters.title: Chapter 750: Ancient Sea Race
paragraphs: The Ancient Sea Race has only ever welcomed one race, and that was the humans. Of course, not all humans were welcomed; however, they once opened their doors to the Wynthralls, the then-life magicians of the human race.
It was safe to say they only ever saw the Wynthralls, as the only worthy race they considered equals.
However, after the battle of parting, they separated from the rest of the world and never interacted with the outside world ever again
But while they never came out, they surely knew everything that was going on outside.
Naturally, this was possible because of the hand.

Years back, when the hand was established, they came into an agreement with the Sea race. They will provide them with information in exchange for a space to set up their headquarters on the Black Sea.
This was received well by the Sea Race and since then, they have had a cordial relationship with the hand. However, they never even bother to come out and see things for themselves.
They saw the races in the outside world as worthless.
However, things have changed now. This change came when the hand informed them of a name and a reason to be wary of that name.
Kent Madson.
They didn’t think much of him at first, but they do now, for they had just received two reasons to... even more reasons, in fact.

A few days ago, Thalorin, the outer sea guardian, came with some news and a gift. When Kent was passing through to the half-elves’ kingdom, the dragon that blocked him and tried to kill him did as Kent told him to.

So he reported to his leaders, and while he was scolded, he wasn’t killed like he had expected. Of course, his punishment wouldn’t free him from his duties anytime soon. But even so, he was happy he wasn’t killed.
When he relayed the message to his leaders, a meeting that hadn’t taken place in thousands of years was soon to happen.

This meeting would bring together the leaders of the seven sea kingdoms to discuss the recent events. Of course, while it may sound ominous, the meeting was actually only to see if they could gain something from getting to know Kent Madson.
However, a few hours before the meeting, they received different news, causing the meeting to be rescheduled for the next day.
This time, instead of just the seven leaders, the leader of all seven kingdoms, Ocean Master Levaithan, joined them for the news they received was one they never expected.
[Arc Dome - Ancient Leviathan City]
Arc Dome is a city approximately 45 kilometers in diameter. It is the home of the Ocean Master, the only survivor of the ancient Ocean Leviathans in the world of Sonox.

In the ancient Sea Race, he is the strongest and oversees the protection of all seven kingdoms. Of course, after the battle of parting, he hadn’t really done anything aside from rebuilding and firming his foundation for the past 25 thousand years.
He participated in the Battle of Parting, and while many living in the world had also participated in that war, Lord Leviathan was a Peak core formation expert at the time.

He led the Sea Race in the battle, and to this day, his legend still echoes in the deeper reaches of the world. He fought beside the Humans, and when the war was over, he retreated to the Arc Dome, only coming out to explore once every five centuries.
But today, he came out and was about to meet to discuss the future of the Sea Race, for while Kent Madson is a threat, the news they received on the Half-Elves told them something different.

Inside a large hall, built entirely from glass and jade, eight people were seated. Seated at the main chair is a man clad in dark robes. He is sitting in a sleek throne made using the finest wood and polished using star dust.
He appeared to be in his late 40s, and judging by his posture, he had some muscle tone. He is no weakling.

Lord Levaithan has no aura around him. It was as if he were the weakest person one would ever meet. If one doesn’t know him, they would think he isn’t even a cultivator, for his aura has been refined to the point he could control it at will.
He has silver hair, handsome facial features, and intimidating red eyes.
But he wasn’t the only one with no aura in the hall. Sitting on both right and left, away from his throne, are the seven leaders of the sea race.
After Lord Leviathan, they are the next strongest of the sea race.
Lord Levaithan sat there calmly for a few minutes before he started to speak.
"We all know why we are here, so let’s get this over with." The seven leaders nodded,
"My lord, we received words from our spies in the outside world. It appeared the surface world is about to grow stronger if we dont step in.
According to the reports, they are now in possession of several treasures that we have no idea where they originated from.
I dont know if these reports are exaggerated, but judging by how it was sent, I have all the reasons to believe the surface world would grow too powerful soon."

"You said nothing concrete, King Zephyr. What had they gotten that made you think they could surpass us? Bear in mind, aside from the Supreme Immortal Sect, we are the only race with a connection to other worlds.
When it comes to resources, we have more than enough, so why would they threaten our standing as the strongest in the world?"
Lord Zephyr paled a little when the ocean master questioned him. Lord Zephyr is the king of the Manta Rays.
They are known for their combat strength, for when it comes to those with a natural affinity for lightning, they are the best in the world.
In fact, during the battle of parting, the Manta Rays led the charge and fought bravely like the warriors they were.
King Zephyr himself can be considered the third strongest in the sea race. But even he paled when he was questioned directly by the Ocean Master.
Just a few words from him were enough to cause someone who had refined all seven cores 12 years ago to turn pale.
King Zaphyr quickly made his report vivid and concise.
"The report shows they have treasures like an immortal grade Ambrosia apple, 10,000-year-old Spirit Grape Fruit, Soul Cleansing Fruits, and more.

Naturally, all this can be purchased at the alliance headquarters; however, what called for this meeting was the discovery that they have a mysterious alchemist who can concoct a Tier 8 Innate Talent awakening Pill..."
"What did you just say?"
Lord Levaithan, who had been resting on his throne, suddenly lifted his back and questioned in a tone that made all seven Sea Leaders pale immediately.
